Sends the gadget to an address. The gadget then gives a gadget event with the event data 0, which tells that the page has loaded. Going to an address drops the pages that were forward of the current one.
@param htmlview  The handle from [CreateHtmlView](CreateHtmlView).
@param URL       The address to go to.
